uxAdmin.redeemConfirm: Redeem {reward} for {cost} XP at {event}? A temporary code opens immediately. Its exact expiry is shown on the code; show it to crew before it expires.
uxAdmin.activeCodes: Active reward codes · show to crew
uxAdmin.balanceEnough: You have enough XP. Redemption also needs an eligible event.
uxAdmin.redeemNeedsCheckIn: To redeem, check in with crew at an event while check-in is open.
uxAdmin.claimBonusBody: Normal check-in XP is automatic. After an event, report eligible contributions here for crew review. This does not collect attendance XP.
uxAdmin.claimEventUnavailable: This event is not eligible for a bonus claim. Choose an eligible ended event above.
uxAdmin.workspaceHint: Choose one event to work on attendance, reservations, claims, rewards, draw and recap together.

uxAdmin.scanClosed: Check-in is closed. Scanning is available only during an open check-in window.

uxAdmin.reportedSalesSource: Reported by crew in the event recap.

uxAdmin.recapAfterEvent: The recap can be recorded after this event ends.
uxAdmin.drawNotReady: Run the draw while the event is open and in progress, after the prize is configured and every draw slot is filled.
uxAdmin.replaceWarning: The old card will be permanently revoked and a replacement added to the print queue. A revoked card cannot be repaired or used.

uxAdmin.replacementReason: Why does this card need replacement?
uxAdmin.repairBody: Use repair only when the delivered card's NFC chip still responds. HQ must authorize one repair; the approval belongs to its requester and expires.
uxAdmin.repairAlreadyRequested: A repair request or authorization is already active. Check its owner and expiry below.
uxAdmin.repairReason: What is wrong with the readable card?

uxAdmin.offAppPayment: Payment happens outside this app. Recording confirms money already received.
uxAdmin.confirmFee: Confirm that {amount} has already been received outside the app. This records the payment once.
